Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Marley, a sweet girl with a silly side to discover!

Marley like having time to get comfortable with new people, and once she does, her playful personality shines. She loves chasing bouncy balls, exploring agility equipment and rolling around in the grass. Marley is currently in foster with another dog and is enjoying the company of her canine companion. She feels most comfortable in quieter, suburban surroundings where she can enjoy life away from busy city noise. Ready to get to know Marley? Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Marley’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
